The current submission checklist marks the investigator/evaluator exchange complete under that same requirement and records a team/submission workflow.
The README labels the repository an Open Agent Hackathon 2026 Track 3 submission and describes the investigator and evaluator as code in the same bounded workflow.
All twelve latest commits inspected through the current head have the same GitHub author and committer account; a co-author/provider label does not authenticate a separate operator.
The one reported model call occurs after the investigator/evaluator adjudication and does not prove those role labels are independently operated model instances.
